title: XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management
abstract: arXiv:2611.31498v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to compare the importance of CGM and insulin-history inputs and summarize insulin-history attributions over three 20-minute windows motivated by insulin-on-board. We assess whether these attributions correspond to policy-output sensitivity through targeted input replacement and compare temporal rankings with TimeSHAP. translated_title: XRL4T1D：用于1型糖尿病管理的强化学习事后可解释性框架
translated_abstract: 1型糖尿病（T1D）需要终身胰岛素治疗，强化学习（RL）在UVA/Padova模拟器中已展现出自动给药的前景。然而，RL控制器的决策仍然难以解释。我们提出了XRL4T1D，这是一个事后可解释性框架，可以在无需重新训练的情况下评估预训练的胰岛素给药策略。每个策略使用60分钟的连续血糖监测（CGM）和已给药胰岛素历史记录（每5分钟采样一次）来推荐胰岛素剂量。我们使用SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）来比较CGM输入和胰岛素历史输入的重要性，并受“体内胰岛素量”概念的启发，将胰岛素历史的归因总结为三个20分钟的时间窗口。我们通过有针对性的输入替换来评估这些归因是否与策略输出的敏感性相对应，并将时间排序结果与TimeSHAP进行比较。在全部80个患者-策略-掩码大小的案例中，替换归因最高的输入会改变（策略的输出）……
tldr: 本文提出XRL4T1D框架，无需重新训练即可利用SHAP等方法对1型糖尿病胰岛素给药的强化学习策略进行事后解释，揭示了CGM血糖值与胰岛素历史输入对决策的重要性。
en_tdlr: XRL4T1D is a post-hoc explainability framework that uses SHAP-based analysis to interpret pretrained reinforcement learning insulin-dosing policies for type 1 diabetes management without retraining.
